content.title: 1 Cash-Producing Stock to Own for Decades and 2 We Avoid
content.summary: A company that generates cash isn’t automatically a winner. Some businesses stockpile cash but fail to reinvest wisely, limiting their ability to expand.

content.title: 3 Russell 2000 Stocks Walking a Fine Line
content.summary: Small-cap stocks in the Russell 2000 (^RUT) can be a goldmine for investors looking beyond the usual large-cap names. But with less stability and fewer resources than their bigger counterparts, these companies face steeper challenges in scaling their businesses.

content.title: 1 Profitable Stock to Target This Week and 2 Facing Headwinds
content.summary: While profitability is essential, it doesn’t guarantee long-term success. Some companies that rest on their margins will lose ground as competition intensifies - as Jeff Bezos said, "Your margin is my opportunity".

content.title: 1 Stock Under $10 to Consider Right Now and 2 That Underwhelm
content.summary: Investors can certainly boost their returns by concentrating on stocks trading between $1 and $10. However, a disciplined approach is necessary because many of these businesses are speculative and lack the underlying fundamentals to support their prices.

content.title: 3 Small-Cap Stocks with Warning Signs
content.summary: Small-cap stocks can be incredibly lucrative investments because their lack of analyst coverage leads to frequent mispricings. However, these businesses (and their stock prices) often stay small because their subscale operations make it harder to expand their competitive moats.
